decisions.reason: Changing the Unit 1 bathroom door from sliding to hinged does not alter the en-suite layout, fixture locations, or recorded door location; door operation is owned by the separate source Requirement.

The door-type change does not modify the requirement to display dimensions. The source message's dimension requests are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY and are independent of the source decision.
The source decision concerns the Unit 1 bathroom door type and does not change Unit 3 bathroom geometry or fixture placement.
The Unit 1 bathroom door-type change has no necessary effect on Unit 3 toilet drain routing.
Changing a bathroom door from sliding to hinged does not necessarily change any recorded partition-wall construction or demolition decision.
The Unit 1 bathroom door operation is unrelated to kitchen cabinetry, enclosure, dimensions, or appliance placement.
The source changes an internal Unit 1 bathroom door type and does not entail a change to the common corridor or entrance-hall layout.
